confirmed_findings.title: Internal and external reconciliation figures differ in measure
confirmed_findings.description: The internal GBP reconciliation reported requirement and resource as equal on 2026-09-17 and 2026-09-30, while the external reconciliation reported lower bank balances than ledger balances on those dates.
confirmed_findings.establishes: The internal records report equal requirement and resource at the two retrieved dates. The external records report a bank balance lower than the ledger balance at those dates.
confirmed_findings.audit_relevance: The internal requirement-versus-resource result does not explain the separate difference between the external account ledger and bank balance.
confirmed_findings.does_not_establish: The internal reconciliation does not establish why the external bank and ledger balances differ or the treatment of the bank entry described in F-03.
confirmed_findings.evidence_relationship: On 2026-09-17 the internal reconciliation reports requirement and resource of 341484.46 and difference 0.00; the external reconciliation reports ledger 341484.46 and bank 340672.06. On 2026-09-30 the internal figures are 395844.86 and 0.00 difference; external figures are ledger 395844.86 and bank 395032.46. These are different reconciliation measures, not contradictory records of the same measure.
